title: Extremely disappointed.
text:
Extremely disappointed.. [[VIDEOID:60b3421b37e146146d8ec5101f5d2b2]] This kit seems to be on a deal due to some issues with the brown keg that's included in the kit.
I am an AVID Mr. Beer fan since these smaller kegs are easier to use and allows a new brewer to experiment with smaller batches (versus a 5+ gallon batch).
The spout helps limit the need for a bottling bucket.
I have not had a leak issue with any other Mr. Beer kits (I have 3 Mr Beer kegs currently).
I received this kit and was going to prove to other reviewers that it was merely a spigot issue rather than a faulty keg issue.
I sanitized the brown keg with the sanitizer in the sink and didn't notice any real issues.
I filled the keg with cold water and began the brew process.
I noticed some water on the counter but figured it was just runoff from the sanitizing solution I had poured out.
Once the boil was all done I was ready to cool the wort and put in the keg but there was even more water. I picked up the keg and saw that along the seam on the bottom of the brown fermenter there was water dripping out rather steadily.
I had the brew all mixed up so I then sanitized and leak checked the clear fermenter and there are no issues.
I'm hoping to get some form of refund or replacement keg from Amazon/Mr Beer as this is extremely disappointing.
THOROUGHLY check your fermenter before starting anything. Put a towel underneath just to be safe during the leak check, otherwise you may be initially fooled as I was.
Check out the video for the leak issue.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Beer Hacked RootBeer Kit
features: This Kit includes two reusable brew kegs with a built in air-lock, an easy-pour tap and a wide mouth opening for easy clean up.
Everything needed to produce a case of great-tasting, home-brewed Hard Root Beer, including beer and rootbeer mixes with Booster, yeast and No-Rinse Cleanser. Sugar Not Included
Eleven reusable plastic PET bottles; enough for a full batch of Hacked RootBeer. Complete with caps, special CO2 release gasket tops and self-adhesive labels
Easy-to-follow instructions to answer all of your home-brewing questions. An excellent resource for beginning brewers.
This kit makes 2 gallons of great tasting Alcoholic RootBeer (5% ABV)
description: Growing up, there was no better treat than a creamy, old-fashioned root beer. Deliciously sweet and perfectly carbonated, root beer has always been one of our nation's favorite soda pops. Now, Mr. Beer has decided to take this beloved beverage up a notch with an adult twist: say hello to Hacked Root Beer. At first sip, notes of vanilla and licorice take the forefront, followed by the frothy, full-bodied flavor root beer is famous for. But don't let that sweet exterior fool you, because this root beer has been hacked with 5% ABV and can deliver quite the punch. This Hacked Root Beer may not be suitable for work, but we guarantee it will be the first thing you reach for when you get home. In recent years, hard root beer popularity has sky rocketed, but the popular brands can be hard to come by. With Mr. Beer's Hacked Root Beer, it doesn't matter where you live because you can make your very own alcoholic root beer from home in just 6 weeks.
